AFTER.text:
AFTER(G)>NAME := f1(x0)    [reproduces 78/78 shown examples; answers]
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where f1(#0:G) -> N := nthN(order, add(index_of(order, f0(#0)), 1))

BEFORE.text:
BEFORE(G)>NAME := nthN(order, sub(index_of(order, f0(x0)), 1))    [reproduces 78/78 shown examples; answers]
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))

BETWEEN.text:
BETWEEN(G,G)>NAME := f1(x0)    [reproduces 72/72 shown examples; answers]
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where f1(#0:G) -> N := nthN(order, add(index_of(order, f0(#0)), 1))

CHAIN.text:
AFTER then OTHER_CASE := compose of the parts' programs, in order (a NAME passed on to a glyph slot is the name's first TEACH exemplar)
  AFTER(G)>NAME := f1(x0)
  OTHER_CASE(G;cands)>PICK := compose(&SAME(G)>NAME, &POINT(N;cands)>PICK)
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where f1(#0:G) -> N := nthN(order, add(index_of(order, f0(#0)), 1))
  where @POINT(N;cands)>PICK := argmaxG(cands, λa. maxofG(taught(x0), λb. sim(b, a)))
  where @SAME(G)>NAME := f0(x0)

LOOP.text:
LOOP(G)>YESNO := @IS(N,G)>YESNO(@CONST(G)>NAME(x0), x0)    [reproduces 186/228 shown examples; answers]
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where @IS(N,G)>YESNO := eq(f0(x1), x0)
  where @CONST(G)>NAME := nthN(order, 0)

MIRROR.text:
MIRROR(G)>YESNO := compose(&AFTER(G)>NAME, compose(&TWO_AFTER(G)>NAME, compose(&TWO_AFTER(G)>NAME, &VOWEL(G)>YESNO)))    [reproduces 174/216 shown examples; answers]
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where f1(#0:G) -> N := nthN(order, add(index_of(order, f0(#0)), 1))
  where @VOWEL(G)>YESNO := @LOOP(G)>YESNO(x0)
  where @LOOP(G)>YESNO := @IS(N,G)>YESNO(@CONST(G)>NAME(x0), x0)
  where @IS(N,G)>YESNO := eq(f0(x1), x0)
  where @AFTER(G)>NAME := f1(x0)
  where @CONST(G)>NAME := nthN(order, 0)
  where @TWO_AFTER(G)>NAME := compose(&AFTER(G)>NAME, &AFTER(G)>NAME)

OTHER_CASE.text:
OTHER_CASE(G;cands)>PICK := compose(&SAME(G)>NAME, &POINT(N;cands)>PICK)    [reproduces 36/36 shown examples; answers]
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where @POINT(N;cands)>PICK := argmaxG(cands, λa. maxofG(taught(x0), λb. sim(b, a)))
  where @SAME(G)>NAME := f0(x0)

TWO_AFTER.text:

  where f1(#0:G) -> N := nthN(order, add(index_of(order, f0(#0)), 1))
  where @AFTER(G)>NAME := f1(x0)

VOWEL.text:
VOWEL(G)>YESNO := @LOOP(G)>YESNO(x0)    [reproduces 264/312 shown examples; answers]
